claim.quote: No signal consistent with the dark matter interaction is identified, and rules out model-dependent dark matter interpretations of the DAMA signals in the specific context of standard halo model with the same NaI(Tl) target for various interaction hypotheses.

name: Strong constraints from COSINE-100 on the DAMA dark matter results using the same sodium iodide target

summary.plain: Using 1.7 years of data and better event selection, COSINE-100 found no signal and ruled out, for the standard halo model, several ways of explaining the DAMA signals with dark-matter scattering on the same sodium-iodide target.
summary.technical: 1.7 years of COSINE-100 data with improved event selection and background model; model-dependent exclusion of interpretations of the DAMA signals (standard halo model, various interaction hypotheses) (Sci. Adv. 7, eabk2699 (2021)). The abstract says the experiment is 'aimed at testing DAMA's claim of dark matter observation'.

title: Strong constraints from COSINE-100 on the DAMA dark matter results using the same sodium iodide target
why_it_matters: A direct model-dependent test of DAMA's signal with the same target.
